WITH filtered_results AS (
  SELECT 
    cr.raceId,
    cr.points
  FROM constructorResults cr
  WHERE cr.points > 1.0
),
race_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    r.name as raceName,
    AVG(fr.points) as per_race_avg,
    COUNT(fr.points) as result_count
  FROM filtered_results fr
  JOIN races r ON fr.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
),
race_name_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    raceName,
    AVG(per_race_avg) as race_name_avg
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY raceName
)
SELECT 
  ra.raceId,
  ra.raceName,
  ra.per_race_avg,
  ra.result_count,
  ra.per_race_avg / rna.race_name_avg as ratio
FROM race_averages ra
LEFT JOIN race_name_averages rna ON ra.raceName = rna.raceName
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
